body:
Two previously-scoped mechanisms (GNU statement-expression, synthesized helper function) were both real dead ends -- confirmed live the GNU approach fails -pedantic, and the helper approach needs real free-variable capture. Found a third: hoist the binding form's own statements directly into the SAME enclosing C statement list, sidestepping capture entirely (no new scope boundary). New emit_if_condition(), wired into all 4 real if-in-statement-position call sites, reusing the existing emit_match_clause_body() dispatcher. make test: 347/347, including 2 updated regression tests now asserting correct compile+run behavior instead of honest failure. Commit 67fd3fd.

⚓ ☃
title: S223-02: let/match/loop actually work as an if's own condition
